title: Mutation coverage of the selected finite invoice (invoice_allcold acceptance boundary)
body:
# Mutation coverage of the selected finite invoice

**Aaron Wang**, with help from opencode (substantial AI assistance; no independent human review claimed). Adversarial audit; no kappa, certificate, supplier or frontier change.

## Scope

One named current condition of the selected [PR 1094](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1094) chain: the frozen [PR 1087](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1087) `code/invoice_allcold.py` (SHA-256 `71eb5751...58a8`, inside `research/complex-t16-rare-pattern-exchanges/upstream1087.tar.gz`), which is the finite-invoice stage of the strict replay. Its `run()` carries the finite inequalities that gate the selected composition (the prefix obligation `required_prefix < 512`, the row obligation `physical_row_coefficient < 20161`, the halving guard, and five more) and it has no mutation-control block of its own. This PR answers open question 3 of `research/t16-audit-mutant-coverage` (https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1959, Josie Elliston): "mutation-test the invoice", and, through a downstream probe, whether the 69 admission controls cover the invoice's inputs.

Task selection: chooser track `adversarial-audit`, card `supplier-boundary-audit`, OS nonce `7e410ad2f528cd7f194fd3f8f5b52fde`, base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. **Scope status: refined.** The drawn first-choice card `selected-stock-envelope` collided with philippeVV's fresh live claim on the discussion board (discussions/1166, 2026-10-14 18:57Z, updates 19:21Z), so the second-choice card was taken per the pair-collision rule and refined to the explicit, unclaimed open handoff question 3 above. Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18933773. The full task card is committed as `research/invoice-mutant-coverage/task-card.md`, structured metadata as `TASK.json`.

## Evidence

Package `research/invoice-mutant-coverage/`. The harness runs the pinned `invoice_allcold.run()` in-process over the archived selected fixture `research/community-frontier1094-audit/selected-replay.tar.gz` (pin `f1da8061...29d6`), mutating input files in place and restoring them.

**Positive control.** On the unmutated fixture the stage reproduces the archived selected `PREFIX-AND-INVOICE.json` and `GLOBAL-PREFIX.json` exactly, every field.

**Census: 37 semantic mutants; 31 rejected by the invoice at named statements, 6 accepted by the invoice alone. Every accepted mutant is rejected by the downstream receipt admission (`assemble.py`, the layer the 69 admission controls exercise). No mutant tested passes both layers.**

| Mutant class | Count | Rejected by run() | Accepted by run() |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| A raw template fields (stored hashes stale) | 2 | 2 | 0 |
| B hash-consistent template fields | 11 | 11 | 0 |
| C audit-receipt fields | 14 | 10 | 4 |
| D provider inputs | 4 | 4 | 0 |
| F fully consistent stock inflation | 2 | 1 | 1 |
| E retained-invoice fields | 4 | 3 | 1 |

The six accepted mutants and where the downstream layer rejects each:

| Mutant | What run() accepts | Where assemble() rejects it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `C3b_owner_profile_same_mass_same_max` | owner profile reshuffled at equal rank mass and max rank | line 130: idle-remainder split must stay nonnegative |
| `C4_owner_explicit_idle_remainders` | `explicit_idle_remainder_children` raised by one | line 69: SPEC literal `expected.idle_remainders` = 7526 |
| `C6_owner_actual_73column_sigmas` | `actual_73column_sigmas` raised by one | line 68: SPEC literal `expected.actual_73column_sigmas` = 10002 |
| `C10_control_mutation_claims_cleared` | controller audit's own mutation claims cleared | line 75: invoice and owner receipts must record the same controller audit hash |
| `F2_consistent_stock_inflation_row_subthreshold` | stock inflated about 2^1840-fold, all identities consistent | line 67: SPEC literal `expected.rank_mass` = 1041408 |
| `E2_retained_previous_bound_zero` | retained invoice's `conservative_pervertex_used` set to 0 | line 153: retained prior allowance must be a positive integer |

**Smallest falsifying instance for the row obligation.** Mutants `F1`/`F2` are a boundary pair: fully hash-consistent template, owner and parent stock inflation preserving every `run()` arithmetic identity including the deficit literal `m*live-mass == deficit == 5120`, aimed exactly at the guard `row = 2*stock_bits + 11185 < 20161`. `F1` reaches stock bit length 4488 (row exactly 20161) and is rejected at the inequality block; `F2`, one stock bit less (4487, row 20159), passes the invoice alone with every strict check true. One bit of stock width separates rejection from acceptance. Below the threshold the invoice does not anchor the stock; the anchors are the downstream SPEC pins and the driver-level literals.

**Coverage answer for open question 3.** The 69 admission controls mutate the two receipts and require `assemble()` to reject; they do not touch the invoice's input files. The invoice's input bindings are enforced one layer down as recorded in the table above, and the stock identity at the selected values is additionally bound by `verify_t16.py`'s final literals (`rank_mass` 1041408, `deficit` 5120, row below 20161) with the independent `indep16.py` recount; that last binding is a static reading of the driver source, not executed here.

## Reproduce

Standard library only, CPython 3.10+; the registered replay uses 3.12.

```sh
python3 -B research/invoice-mutant-coverage/verify.py
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s research/invoice-mutant-coverage -p test_package.py
```

Observed on CPython 3.12 (Windows): `PASS_INVOICE_MUTANT_COVERAGE 37 mutants: 31 rejected, 6 accepted`, and 3 tests OK. Registered replay: `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/invoice-mutant-coverage` prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/invoice-mutant-coverage outcome=completed`; `--check-only` prints `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`. `--write` regenerates `EXPECTED.json` after an intentional harness change. Nothing is written outside a fresh temporary directory; the retained vendor invoice is asserted unchanged after all retained-invoice mutants, which run on a scratch copy.

## Remaining obligations

Not checked: well-formed provider program mutations with resynchronized registry and hashes (the recount chain closes over them and needs its own synthesis harness); the `emit` and `audit` stages; `audit_allcold.py` (the object of https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1959); executed `verify_t16.py` / `indep16.py` coverage on the F2 fixture; any claim about kappa, the certificate or supplier admission. The census is evidence about this fixture and these 37 mutants, not a completeness proof for arbitrary mutations. Three open next questions with first steps and blockers are in the package README and `TASK.json`.

## Credit and predecessor notes

The audited stage is the [PR 1087](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1087) archive's `code/invoice_allcold.py`, adapted from the retained [PR 558](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/558)/[PR 552](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/552)/[PR 531](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/531) invoice lineage (Jeremy Kothe's [PR 870](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/870)/[PR 1087](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1087) chain with Hao Yan's (@FanPUYen) [PR 858](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/858) T16 edits). Rohan Arun's [PR 1094](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1094) supplies the selected exchanges and the archived run; the maintainer's `research/community-frontier1094-audit` archived the fixture. Josie Elliston's `research/t16-audit-mutant-coverage` (https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1959) posed the exact open question and supplied the harness pattern; jackmgaller's https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1939 explains the copy cost this harness avoids by mutating files in place. The downstream admission controls and `assemble.py` are the same [PR 1087](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1087) code. Frozen source pins and `upstream/` are unchanged.
